sections.h2: Tamil Nadu's GST growth slid from 22.1% to −0.7% over three years

chart.title: Domestic GST growth decelerated for three straight years before turning negative
chart.sub: Year-on-year change in Tamil Nadu domestic GST collection, %.

sections.means: Tamil Nadu's domestic GST collection grew more slowly each year and fell 0.7% in FY2025-26.
sections.todo: Read the four enforcement measures against monthly collection data before judging whether they are working.

sections.h2: Real growth of 10.83% did not reach GST collection in FY2025-26

chart.title: The state's economy grew about 11% in real terms while GST shrank
chart.source: GSTN Statistics portal; state GSDP estimates as cited in the post.

sections.means: Real GSDP grew 10.83% and manufacturing over 15% in FY2025-26, yet GST collection fell 0.7%.
sections.todo: Test whether the gap is capture rather than growth by comparing manufacturing GST with e-way bill volumes.

sections.h2: Tamil Nadu's registered businesses grew faster than most of its peers

chart.title: Registrations rose 38.7% in a year, behind only Karnataka's 45.2%
chart.sub: Growth in active GST-registered businesses, April 2025 to April 2026, %.

sections.means: Tamil Nadu's taxpayer base widened faster than Maharashtra and Gujarat, so the revenue gap is not a shortage of registrants.
sections.todo: Find a services-side compliance tool that reaches the 53% of gross state value added that goods-movement measures miss.
